steps.text: Burn this view of the city into your memories.
Every time a new skyscraper is built, countless old buildings are inevitably torn down. It is this thick layer of dust, accumulated over tens of hundreds of years, that made today's Londinium.
When you inherit these lands, not only will you inherit the extravagant furs you see on the outside. You must also accept the scars that lie underneath.
It is extraordinarily difficult to build a new house among these old ones.
Your eyes need to be able to see through the flesh and into the bones to find the place with the firmest foundation that can support the entire city.
This will be your starting point.
Vina, it is when you forget everything that you must inherit that you will truly become a proper successor.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege, please think this through again. Follow my advice.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: We must leave this place, this dark underground cavern at once.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Only timid metal crabs and insects hide underground. I can't stand hiding down here while our enemies are wreaking havoc above our heads.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You know, the way you talk is really getting on my nerves...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: How could you call any of them spineless when every one of them stands up against the Sarkaz? If they were actually the cowards you make them out to be, they would've gone working for the Sarkaz long ago!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Don't get the wrong idea. I'm not trying to assign blame, but... there is only so much they can do.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What do you mean, there is only so much they can do? Remember who it was that saved you when you made it out of Londinium, half-dead? How come you didn't say there was only so much we could do?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I don't want to argue with you.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I'm not arguing with you either, but I don't want to hear your cranky little mouth either.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Morgan and I told you when you first ran into us a year ago or so. If you wanted to join the Glasgow family, you'd have to rid yourself of your shitty aristocratic attitude.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Let me say a word on her behalf. Dagda's working very hard too. She's changed quite a bit.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: At a glance, no one could tell that she used to be a knight-noble.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Right, I learned a lot... from all of you. I'm sure you know that I've long thought of myself as a part of Glasgow.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: But now we're back in Londinium, I just can't help but be aware that I'm also a Knight of the Tower.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Don't you think that anything has changed just because we're back in Londinium.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Do you know how many eyes are on Vina? We've never been safe. No, it's exactly because we're back now that we're especially in danger.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I agree with you on that.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: And it's out of safety considerations that I think we should leave these militants we don't know the first thing about.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Dagda, you mean you're worried the resistance could act against Vina?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Their membership is too much of a mixed bag... What if some of them don't actually mean well?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Where do you think we should go, then?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: As far as I know, there are still some in the city that we can count on. My mother's friends.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I couldn't contact them before the Knights of the Tower fell, but the way I see it... now might be a good time.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You mean... You want us to turn to the nobles?!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Who do you think murdered Vina's dad and forced her to hide out on the streets for years?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Who do you think... hunted us down and chased us out of Londinium? We don't even know if Baird and the rest of the gang are still alive!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The nobles weren't of one mind back then... but after the Sarkaz came...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hah... you think the Sarkaz are our only enemy?!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Listen up, my lady! You want to hand Vina over to those dirty lords? Over my dead body!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hannah!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: What are you doing, shouting like that? Do you want everyone to know who Vina is?!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Both of you, calm down. Fighting can't solve everything, especially at a crucial moment like this!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Until you've really thought through the consequences of your bickering, you'd better shut your mouths.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: What do you want Vina to...?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It doesn't matter.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina? W-What do you have in mind?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I think Dagda's worries are reasonable. We followed Amiya and the Doctor here, but... in the end, our objective isn't the same as theirs.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: All they have to do is stop the Sarkaz in the city, and that's exactly what the resistance has been trying to do.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: But we...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What do you think our objective is?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Morgan, Indra.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Why did you recognize me as your leader, back then?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Because Glasgow needed to survive in Londinium.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: We were still kids, and we made a lot of enemies. A lot of street punks had their eyes on us, and there were even a couple bad cops who always gave us trouble...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina, you're so much more incredible than the rest of us.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You're the one who taught me that a good boss doesn't just fight. Not only did you lead us out of trouble, you recruited so many faces into the gang, you made Glasgow stronger.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That's why I'm confident you're a good boss, and that you'll be a good leader in the future.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Very good. Looks like we haven't forgotten our convictions.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Have you heard what the resistance commander said?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: They'll save Londinium, but before that, they'll save their brothers and sisters in arms.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Who's to say our objectives are different?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: My hammer was forged to serve this city... to serve Victoria. If my strength can save even just one Victorian, then I have no reason to leave the fight.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dagda.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Sorry... I won't bring that up again.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No, I just wanted to say you aren't in the wrong.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If you have your own mission to accomplish, you needn't follow my every word.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You are a fine knight, but I'm not the one who knighted you.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm not the lord you were born to serve. No... You should find the one you actually want to serve instead of being bound by your bloodline's oath. You're free, and you always have been.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege?!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina, that's a little...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: It's not like Dagda was...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Enough. You heard me well.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dagda, I await your answer.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Understood, Siege.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Commander Clovisia, have you thought about our cooperation proposal?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Amiya... May I call you Amiya? Please call me Clovisia.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah... Of course, Clovisia.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Dr.{@nickname} and you have more than sufficiently explained what your purpose here is. If I'm understanding you correctly, Rhodes Island is a pharmaceutical company that focuses on solving Infected issues?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: To that end, your company has worked with cities and even countries... I also know that most Sarkaz are infected.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: But... I just wanted to make sure about this. Did you come to Londinium with this objective too?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Or is it part of Rhodes Island's business to solve the Sarkaz question as well?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Sarkaz are not a question.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Clovisia, the way we see it, the real issue at hand is the war between the Sarkaz and the Victorians.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This war has already seen more than enough bloodshed on both the Victorian and Sarkaz sides...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If the war escalates further, what happens then? How many countries will be dragged into it? How many people?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We can't allow that to happen.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Amiya, your ideals... are noble. You are Infected, and you want to fight for the Infected. I can understand that... but what do you have to do with the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... I inherited my ideals from a Sarkaz. She was a Sarkaz, but she loved me, a Cautus, and she loved everyone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And Rhodes Island... Rhodes Island was born from her feelings.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island fights for the Infected, the Sarkaz, and all those who are oppressed because we know very well that, in war, they are always neglected by those cruel men who stand at the top.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It doesn't matter how many of arrogant men in positions of power we have to deal with. Our focus will always be those who truly need our help.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The cruel men who stand at the top... eh?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: I see. I can empathize with how you feel, and I very much respect Rhodes Island's ideals.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: However... I hope you can understand that the Self-Salvation Corps is not the same as Rhodes Island. Our people come from different backgrounds and have different ideals. And even so, we are all fighting for the same goal.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: —We want to take back Londinium.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: If we can't be sure that Rhodes Island will always be on our side, even if you could persuade me, I wouldn't be able to persuade my men.

options: We will stand together.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}... Do I have your word?

options: You don't need my word.
What you need is our deeds.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Right, I admit. You've seen for yourself that the Self-Salvation Corps is low on manpower. We can't spare anyone to your cause.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island will not be a burden to the Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: No, you're mistaken, Amiya. Most of us aren't worried about your strength. It might actually be the opposite, even.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Your mission is far too ambitious. Besides, you saw it yourself. The Self-Salvation Corps hides in the gaps and crevices of the city just to make it from one battle to the next.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: If what you actually want is a larger battlefield, and it just so happens that the battlefield is Londinium—

options: You think we can defeat the Sarkaz occupying the city alone?
Only those on the same starting line have the right to vie for control.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I'm surprised you are so honest.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: You are admitting to me that although you don't currently have what it takes to face the Sarkaz—

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: When the time is right, Rhodes Island's objective is to depose the tyrannical Regent?

options: Our objective is much more concrete.
You think we aim to seize Central Londinium.
No harm in supporting an armed group ready to cooperate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... *Cough*...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (That's not what we said before we came...)

options: Amiya, she's a military commander.
Politicians see nothing but bargaining chips.
Merchants smell nothing but profit.
And generals want nothing but power.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This isn't how we usually earn the trust of our collaborators...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No... You're right. Just like how even though we always seek to end wars, we have never been able to avoid one.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Clovisia, our objective is clear. Just like the Self-Salvation Corps, Rhodes Island will fight for the day we successfully stop the Sarkaz Regent.

options: Rhodes Island will provide you medical resources.
Closure's working with your engineers already.
We have other means to show our sincerity.
We will show you Rhodes Island's might in the next fight.
So, Commander Clovisia, is that to your satisfaction?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: ......Dr. {@nickname}... you and Amiya are excellent partners.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: It seems Feist is right. You're the helpers we've been looking for.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What did Mr. Feist...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: He spoke on your behalf in front of me and all the captains.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What about that problem earlier, then?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: He's still young. Even though he has the courage to stand up and speak, he isn't ready to take responsibility for the outcome. This burden is for me to shoulder.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But you're young too.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Haha, but I'm their commander. In my position, you would do the same too, wouldn't you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes... Right, I know you just wanted us to explain our position one more time.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: I hope you don't mind.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: O-Of course I don't mind! Both the Doctor and I are happy... to have found an excellent partner.

options: You're an excellent commander, Clovisia.
The Self-Salvation Corps is impressive.
Thanks, Feist.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, Feist told me about you, but you're still... not what I expected.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: When the reconnaissance team comes back, let us plan out this operation together.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: This will be a rescue mission. I believe your Operators are very experienced in such missions?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: I look forward to working with Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Rockrock, my men just got some news from Lady Golding.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Tell our contact we'll be there right away.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Phew... It's a good thing we got in contact with the Messenger. If it wasn't for her, I'm not sure we would've been able to locate the prison.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Yeah, I only hope this trip will be fruitful.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Right, what's going on with you and Feist.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: I heard you squabbling. Ever since we formed a team together, the two of you always worked together so well, like hand in glove. I've never seen you fight like that.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: We have differing opinions, that's all.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: How do you know you aren't of one mind? You should've talked to him about the past long ago. He may always be banging away at his devices, but he'll listen to you.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Is this why you came along? I didn't know you liked mending relationships as much as welding things together.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Haha, it's all the same to me. You're both good soldiers, and I've always thought of you as siblings.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Watch your nine!

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Phew, that was close... How come there are so many mercenaries out on the streets?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: The Sarkaz are trying to catch us. Rock-5...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Hm... Rock-5 sees our contact. In the bakery up ahead. Go. I'll keep an eye on the mercenaries.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hey, Bill, could you get this part over to Harmo? I think he could use it when he reinforces his grain lorry.
Uh... alright.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hand me the wrench.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Franck's shield, too. I put on a new coat of paint on the surface. That should make it fireproof, but remind him that it's going to crack if he lets it get too hot for too long!
Hm... The technology behind this paint is obsolete.
Why don't you try out Raythean's latest formula? It's kinda expensive, but Engineering came up with a cheap generic version. If you're interested, I can give you a discount.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hot hot hot!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Whoa, you got a hole in your thermal gloves? Are you an engineer for real? Hands are like the most important thing to an engineer!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Gloves are a luxury! I can't grab new ones just because I want to!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Besides, how was I supposed to know you were here? My hands are usually a lot stabler.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Your eyes don't look so good to me either. That's like one of the ten must-have qualities of an engineer.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: *Cough*, Old Bill's to blame for this...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Where did he go? Usually he's the only one to stand next to me.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, when I got here, I saw a group following your lieutenant somewhere.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Didn't he promise to come help me out?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You worried about them?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock left in a hurry. I didn't even have the time to check out Rock-5.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'm worried that brawl this morning could've damaged the drones somehow...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hmm... If you're worried about other stuff, there's no way you'll pop out anything too sturdy.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: This is all we can do, and it's only by doing it well that things will be safer for our friends aboveground, right?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Haha... I didn't expect Rhodes Island's engineer to be so good at comforting people.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? What are you even talking about? I'll have you know I'm Rhodes Island's ace psychological consultant. Even Kal'tsit... uh, a real mean boss of mine comes to me and opens up to destress!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: So, hurry up and hand me the wrench.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Let's get working already! What, you want me to crack a few more jokes to lift your spirits?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: There's gonna be some real intense battles soon. Us Engineering Operators are like the backbone of the backbone. There's no time for all that moping!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Ha... haha... Alright, let's get working.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Right, show me that drone... Rock-17. It's lacking a flight stability module. I took one off my broken babies.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Huh? You sure about that? Are there any patents or anything?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Shh, quiet! I did it behind Dr.{@nickname}'s back!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *cough*.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Now that you know how lucky you are, what are you standing there for? Get me my wrench!

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: W-What did you say...? You saw Lady Golding? What did she say?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Understood... We need to send word about this to the commander right now!

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Nngh—! H-Hostiles! They found us! Rockrock, retreat!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Find the captain! Rebels spotted on Euston Road!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Seize them!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Run!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What's this buzzing thing...? A drone? I get it. You were at the port this morning!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Rock-5—! What's the matter? Did we miss?!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Is it because we didn't calibrate it...? We didn't spot the enemies just now, either... Nngh!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Feline, don't you think that's going to work. It might've worked on the Royal Court's squaddies, but it won't work on us.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Rockrock, is your drone dead?!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: It's okay... Even without it, I can still fight.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Tsk... I didn't expect to take damage from you. Looks like your Arts are no less impressive than your courage.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I'll put in a word for you with my captain and let you die here. You don't have to go to the factory anymore. Saves you a painful death.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Ugh––!

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Rockrock, get going! I'll hold it here!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: No, we'll go together!

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: You need to get Lady Golding's message back...! The Commander must know... She must know... that the Messenger...

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: This message... is very important!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Bill!

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: I believe... in the commander... and I believe in you and Feist.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Listen to me. Stop fighting. We're... all a family. Back then... we were only able to escape because your dad... your dad stood in the Sarkaz's way too.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Go!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: *Cough*... *cough*! What's with the thick smoke... Did he have a grenade?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: How dare you hurt my men! You aren't getting out of this alive!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Captain?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Take him back, and lock him away with the other rebels.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Captain, this guy tried to blow us up and got himself caught in the blast. He won't live much longer.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: He doesn't have to live much longer.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Very well. it's the general's orders, right? Should we go after the rest of them?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Do it.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Don't hold out too much hope, though.
